svg.desc: Banner: the letters MMH-MP in thick rounded strokes, glowing from baby blue to lime green, the subtitle Magic Mayer Home-Made Pedal, and on the right a photo of a guitarist pulling a funny guitar face, framed in a striped retro sun.
